title: Petition of H.T. Drummond, Inc., for a 120-day temporary license under the provisions of Chapter 159A, Section 5, of the General Laws, as amended, for the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for hire over certain public ways in Pembroke, Hanover, Randolph, Scituate, Duxbury, Marshfield and Boston restricted to 15-passenger vans.
